title: On GUI click
event_values: event-player, event-item, event-integer, event-string, event-inventory, event-clicktype

title: Has Custom
syntax_pattern:
%itemstack% has [a] custom enchantment [%-customenchantment%]
%itemstack% has(n't| not) [a] custom enchantment [%-customenchantment%]

title: Has GUI
syntax_pattern:
%player% has [a] gui
slot %number% of %player% is a gui
%player% does(n't| not) have [a] gui
slot %number% of %player% is(n't| not) [a] gui

title: Is Ageable
syntax_pattern:
%entities% ((is|are) ageable|can grow up)
%entities% ((is|are)(n't| not) ageable|can(n't| not) grow up)

title: Command with Permission
description: Make the player execute a command with a temporary permission, when the player finishes executing the command, the permission is removed.
syntax_pattern:
[execute] [the] command %strings% by %players% with perm[ission][s] %strings%
[execute] [the] %players% command %strings% with perm[ission][s] %strings%
(let|make) %players% execute [[the] command] %strings% with perm[ission][s] %strings%

title: Gui Properties
syntax_pattern:
change gui inventory to name %string% and size %number%
change gui shape [of (items|actions)] to %strings%
change gui properties of inventory to name %string% [with %-number% row[s]] and shape [of (items|actions)] to %strings%

title: Register Recipe
syntax_pattern:
(create|register) [new] [custom] shaped recipe with (return|result) %itemstack% using [ingredients] %itemstacks% [with shape %-strings%]
(create|register) [new] [custom] shapeless recipe with (return|result) %itemstack% using [ingredients] %itemstacks%
(create|register) [new] [custom] furnace recipe with (return|result) %itemstack% using [source] %itemstack% [[and] with experience %-number%]

title: Unformat GUI
syntax_pattern:
(unformat|remove|clear|reset) [the] gui slot %numbers% of %players%
(unformat|remove|clear|reset) [all] [the] gui slots of %players%

title: Run When Closing GUI
description: It should be used in [creating or editting a gui](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1245), it is just an extra option to run a code before it closes. This is optinal.

title: All Recipes
description: Returns all server recipes. You can get the [ingredients](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1285) and the [result item](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1305).

title: All commands
description: Returns a list containing all registered commands or scripts commands only.

title: Alphabetical order
description: Will return a list of [objects](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2158) organized in alphabetic order.

title: Command info
description: Get informations about a command.
syntax_pattern:
[the] description of command %string%
command %string%'[s] description
[the] main [command] of command %string%
command %string%'[s] main [command]
[the] permission of command %string%
command %string%'[s] permission
[the] permission message of command %string%
command %string%'[s] permission message
[the] plugin [owner] of command %string%
command %string%'[s] plugin [owner]
[the] usage of command %string%
command %string%'[s] usage
[the] aliases of command %string%
command %string%'[s] aliases
[the] file [location] of command %string%
command %string%'[s] file location

title: Evaluate Function
syntax_pattern:
result of function %string% [with <.+?>]
result of function %string(<.+?>)

title: GUI Value
syntax_pattern:
gui-slot
gui-raw-slot
gui-hotbar-slot
gui-inventory
gui-inventory-action
gui-click-(type|action)
gui-cursor[-item]
gui-[(clicked|current)-]item
gui-slot-type
gui-player
gui-players
gui-inventory-name
gui-slot-id
gui

title: Last Damage Cause
syntax_pattern:
[the] last damage cause of %livingentity%
%livingentity%'[s] last damage cause

title: Knowledge Book
description: It returns a knowledge book (1.12+ only) with given recipes.

title: Knowledge Recipes
description: It returns a list of recipes of a knowledge book. You can either set, add and remove recipes, and clear/delete them all.

title: Last GUI/GUI from id
description: It is used to return the last created gui or a gui from a string id.

title: offline Player from UUID
description:
It get a player from a UUID. If you have Bensku's fork dev23+, you can just use [parse expression](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:901) using the uuid.
Also, the uuid needs to be from a player that already played on your server, else it will return null value.

title: Online Time
description: Returns a [timespan](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2167) of online time of [player](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2160) or of the server. Only the online time of player can be edited.

title: Player Data
description: Returns a [offline player](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2159) as it was a player, which means that you can get some values like money, inventory, enderchest,etc. Maybe all values doesn't work. If you want to change these values, you will have to [save player data](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1255).

title: RGB Color
description:
Returns the rgb color of [item stack](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2152) or [color](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2138). You can set these values only for item stacks, in this case, leather armors.
The RGB color returns a list with 3 numbers and the other expressions returns which one separated.
compatible_addon_version: 1.5.3 (single value of items), 1.6 (list values of items and color)

title: Rabbit Type
description: Returns the type of rabbit. e.g. `black`, `black and white`, `brown`, `gold`, `salt and pepper`, `the killer bunny` and `white`.

title: Recipe ID
description: Starting from minecraft 1.12, the recipes now has a unique id. Recipes registered by minecraft will have a id `minecraft:%the result item's name%`, an old recipe plugin will be `bukkit:%random uuid%`, while TuSKe will have its id as `tuske:%last recipe id + 1%`. Other plugins may have a different format, but always following `<plugin>:<key>`.**Only for Shaped and Shapeless recipes**

title: Recipe Owner
description: Starting from minecraft 1.12, recipes have now the register plugin. If it is a minecraft recipe, it will return as `Minecraft`, if it is an old recipe plugin, it will return as `Bukkit` and everything else will return the plugin's name. **Only for Shaped and Shapeless recipes**

title: Regex Error
description: It contains the last error of a regex. It is setted when there is a error while parsing a string as regex, [replacing](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1303)/[spliting](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1304) a string or checking in the [condition](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1241)

title: Regex Pattern
description: This expression returns some regex patterns that Skript or Bukkit uses most.

title: Split Characters
description: Split a text with [number](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2157) amount of characters. It is used to split the message in chat (the default is 60) and to item's lore.

title: Custom Enchantment
description: It represents a custom enchantment. The values depends of the id name of [registered enchantment](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1252).

title: GUI
description: It represents a gui inventory, where the player can take items away from the inventory. It can be created only with [advanced gui effect](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:1259).

title: Recipe
description: A recipe contains the the ingredients list and the result item.

title: Regex
description: Represents a regex object. For now, it won't have any usage but only for test the pattern. It will have more usage in future versions.

title: Slot Type
description: It represents a type of a inventory slot
type_usage: result slot, crafting slot, armor slot, container slot, quickbar slot, outside slot, fuel slot

title: Make GUI
description:
Used to format a GUI slot inside of GUI creation/editing section.
See also: https://github.com/Tuke-Nuke/TuSKe/wiki/GUI-Manager (Advanced GUI)
syntax_pattern:
(make|format) next gui [slot] (with|to) %itemstack%
(make|format) gui [slot] %strings/numbers% (with|to) %itemstack%
(un(make|format)|remove) next gui [slot]
(un(make|format)|remove) gui [slot] %strings/numbers%
(un(make|format)|remove) all gui [slot]

title: Leader
syntax_pattern:
%player% is leader of his clan
%player% is(n't| not) leader of his clan

title: Cancel Drops
description: Cancels the drops of items, experiences or both in death events, where it won't drop the **player** items (like gamerule KeepInventory), or cancel the item drop of break block event (for minecraft 1.12+ only).
syntax_pattern:
cancel [the] drops
cancel [the] drops of [e]xp[perience][s]
cancel [the] drops of (inventory|items)

title: invite Player To Clan
syntax_pattern:
[make] %player% [a] invite %player% to his clan
send invite of clan from %player% to %player%

title: Remove From Clan
syntax_pattern:
(remove|kick) %player% from his clan
[make] %player% resign from his clan

title: Send Marry
syntax_pattern:
[make] %player% invite %player% to marry
send invite of marry from %player% to %player%

title: Evaluate
description:
This effect will run any Skript effect/condition from a given string or piece of code. The difference between SkQuery's evaluate effect and this is basically it returns all syntaxes errors instead of send them to the console, It can evaluate a long amount of code and see them easily instead of beeing in one line. 
For example, you can run a effect from a string, from a piece of code (without beeing quoted) or the entiry section of code.
Starting from 1.8, you can disallow some syntaxes when evaluating. Read more about it at config file (`TuSKe/config.yml`).
syntax_pattern: eval[uate][ logging [[the] error[s]] in %-objects%][ with safety]: (%-strings%|<.+?>)

title: Virtual inv
syntax_pattern:
virtual <.+?> [inventory] [with size %-number%] [(named|with (name|title)) %-string%]
virtual <.+?> [inventory] [with %-number% row[s]] [(named|with (name|title)) %-string%]
virtual <.+?> [inventory] [(named|with (name|title)) %-string%] with size %-number%
virtual <.+?> [inventory] [(named|with (name|title)) %-string%] with %-number% row[s]

title: Minecraft Version
description: Returns the minecraft version of [player](https://skripthub.net/docs/?search=id:2160).

title: Format GUI
description: See also: https://github.com/Tuke-Nuke/TuSKe/wiki/GUI-Manager (Simple GUI)
syntax_pattern:
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% [to [do] nothing]
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% to close [(using|with) %clicktype% [(button|click|action)]]
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% to (run|exe[cute]) [(using|with) %clicktype% [(button|click|action)]]
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% to [close then] (run|exe[cute]) %commandsender% command %string% [(using|with) perm[ission] %string%][[(,| and)] (using|with) %clicktype% [(button|click|action)]][[(,| and)] (using|with) cursor [item] %itemstack%]
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% to [close then] (run|exe[cute]) function functionName([parameters])[[(,| and)] (using|with) %clicktype% [(button|click|action)]][[(,| and)] (using|with) cursor [item] %itemstack%]
(format|create|make) [a] gui slot [%numbers%] of %players% with %itemstack% to (run|exe[cute]) [gui [click]] event

title: Max Durability
description: Returns the max durability of [item stack](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=2152). i.e. 1561 for diamond sword. You can cancel it.

title: Create a GUI
description:
It creates a new gui with a given id (optional), using a base inventory, and a shape (optional)
For more info, read [this](https://github.com/Tuke-Nuke/TuSKe/wiki/GUI-Manager)
